about: Byōbu art atlas crop boxes (DESIGN §12 #5–6). Boxes are in pixels of the assets-src/images/rinpa/*.jpg masters, inside the painted surface (frame, brocade mount and signatures excluded). Atlas column i (left → right) = 第(i+1)扇 = case panel i+1. Panel crops are 1 : 2.75 (512 × 1408 high/medium, 256 × 704 low). Each crop sits inside one panel of the photographed screen, at least 3 px clear of the paper-hinge seams and the brocade border (checked with edge luminance profiles). Alpha = pigment mask: pixels within ΔE (L weighted ½) of the sampled gold ground go to 0 with a 2 px soft edge; `erase` rects (master pixels) are cleared from the alpha (signatures on the gold). Mobile crops: the same panel at full panel width, 1 : 1.6, top at box.y + mobileY × (box.h − h), opaque, always 560 × 896.

erase.why: artist's signature and seal (法眼土佐光茂筆) on the gold cloud
